cards.title: Maths with the loop variable
cards.body: Inside the loop you can calculate with the loop variable like any other number.

cards.title: f-strings
cards.body: Put `f` before the opening quote and you can drop values straight into the text with `{}`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.code:
for i in range(1, 3):
    print(f"5 x {i} = {5 * i}")
check.explanation: The loop runs for i = 1 and i = 2, and the f-string fills in each value.

exercise.prompt: Read a number N and print its times table from 1 to 10, one line each, in the form `3 x 4 = 12`.
exercise.starterCode:
n = int(input())
# print n x 1 up to n x 10
